messages:
Priya: scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize trace header actions: copy correlation id placement, export behaviors, and a11y labels. pls RSVP.
Alex: I can make it. current idea: left-most Copy Correlation ID, title, right-side permalink + kebab with exports.
Omar: engineering: export HAR for traces >5MB must be async. backend will return export_id and we should show 'Request export' instead of 'Download' in that case.
Maria: accessibility: all icon buttons need aria-labels, menu role=menu, focus management, and toasts with aria-live=polite. chevrons in stacktrace should use aria-pressed.
Ben: keyboard/flow: tab order left->title->right. opening kebab traps focus in menu; Esc returns to kebab. Also support arrow nav and Home/End.
Alex: copy button should copy id + attach runtime/model metadata to an analytics event (data attribute ok). show toast "Correlation ID copied".
Priya: decision asks for the meeting: 1) header vs side-panel for exports 2) exact copy for async menu item 3) final ARIA strings for the three main actions 4) QA checklist for async export flow.
Omar: backend prefers header for discoverability. I'll add export-status endpoint so UI can poll.
deploy-bot: playground build 1855001245 deployed (branch: trace-actions-export-a11y).
Priya: thanks all — dropping pre-read figma link in the calendar invite. see you 9:30am.
